snapshot.text: Air France-KLM, the network airline group spanning Air France, KLM and Transavia, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} in FY2024, while EBITDA was broadly unchanged at {{ebitda@FY2024}}.

Net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}} as net debt increased by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, and the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.

credit_metrics.text: EBITDA was broadly unchanged, down {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, on revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}} at {{revenue@FY2024}}, and operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} after a payment to Virgin in a contract renegotiation and a restructuring provision for the Orly domestic offer.

FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, but FFO to debt fell by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} and interest coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}.

Free cash flow fell to {{fcf@FY2024}} from {{fcf@FY2023}} in FY2023, taking FCF to debt down by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, with capex intensity broadly unchanged at {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, with the fleet up by {{fleet.change@FY2024}} to {{fleet@FY2024}} aircraft and an average age broadly unchanged at {{fleet_age@FY2024}}.

The group launched a cash tender offer on two existing bond tranches and announced its intention to issue new bonds to refinance part of its existing debt.
